$Comment: The flat card an overhead indicator draws a texture on (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/OverheadIndicators/<State_Id>.json with an Icon.TexturePath). Two crossed 64 by 64 quads at half stretch, so a one-block card reads from every angle. Each look swaps its own picture onto this mesh at runtime; the Texture named here is the neutral face the mesh carries on its own and is never what a player sees. Author a square PNG (64 by 64 fills the card exactly) under Items/, NPC/, Characters/ or VFX/ for a look that uses the card. The hit box is the client's own bounding shape for the mesh and nothing collides with it: a marker entity carries no server-side box.
